findings.oracle: Replaced with test_list_models_returns_fully_valid_model_records: iterates ALL returned ModelInfo records (not sampled), asserts each has non-whitespace id/name, provider==HUGGINGFACE, context_window>0, bool capability flags, supports_streaming==True, and that all ids are unique; a parser returning [None,None] or duplicates now fails.

Replaced with test_all_model_ids_match_hub_naming_and_derive_name: iterates entire list (no 20-item prefix), asserts each id has no spaces, at most one '/', no surrounding whitespace, and that model.name equals the independently-derived tail of the id (rsplit('/',1)[-1]); a corrupted id or wrong name derivation in any record fails.

Replaced with test_progress_signal_delivers_args_to_connected_slot: connects a real recorder slot via Qt connect(), emits (50,'Loading tools...'), asserts received==[(50,'Loading tools...')] AND splash.progress==50 AND splash.status=='Loading tools...'; broken signal connection or broken _on_progress_updated slot both fail.

Replaced with test_load_splash_pixmap_loads_real_asset_at_expected_scaled_size: independently loads splash.png directly via QPixmap and applies KeepAspectRatio scaling to derive expected dimensions, then asserts the production method returns a non-null pixmap with matching width and height; fallback pixmap or mis-scaled output fails.

Replaced with test_splash_operations_drive_correct_state_transitions: removes try/except entirely; after show() asserts isVisible()==True, after each set_progress asserts exact progress int, exact status string, and progress_animation.endValue() matches the set value, after hide() asserts isVisible()==False; silently broken operations now fail on state assertions.
